clips.title: The story
paras: The Hall of Arms serves as the headquarters of Ironforge's military might and the chief arsenal of the dwarven kingdom. Located within the Military Ward, this fortified compound trains dwarven combatants and orchestrates the deployment of heavy armor and aerial war machines.

Situated in the southeastern corner of the Military Ward, the Hall of Arms is the operational command center for the armed forces of Ironforge. Beyond housing veteran trainers for warriors and hunters, the expansive facility serves as a massive depot and staging ground for mechanized warfare. Heavy steam tanks are assembled and maintained on-site to reinforce Alliance battlefields, while gyrocopters and flying machines are brought up via industrial conveyor belts and launched directly through vertical access shafts in the cavern ceiling toward the Ironforge Airfield above.
